subject: Next steps after discovery — vendor setup pending (W-9 / portal)
messages: Subject: Next steps after discovery — vendor setup pending (W-9 / portal)

Hi Sam — great call today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and clear next steps so we don't lose momentum:

- Scope: Confirmed Redwood Dedicated for analytics API (3 GPUs, 24/7 throughput target)
- Technical kickoff: your infra lead will accept the portal invite so we can schedule the onboarding window
- Procurement: your finance team needs a Redwood vendor profile (W-9) + ACH onboarding to complete vendor setup

Action items: 
1) Sam / Procurement: upload W-9 and confirm ACH routing or tell me if you need a PO instead (I can route to our finance ops).
2) Lauren / Redwood: will re-send portal invite and a short guide for procurement to make acceptance straightforward (attached).
3) Karthik: stand by to help with pricing/contract Qs and to accelerate kickoff once procurement clears the portal step.

Attachments: BR-NextSteps-Redwood.docx (one-pager), sample vendor portal screenshot. I also attached a copy of the W-9 we submitted last week for your records — if you already have it in procurement systems, ignore that attachment.

If the priority has shifted on your side, totally fine — just reply with the expected timeline and I’ll adjust our onboarding window. Otherwise, can you confirm by end of week so we can lock a date?

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.in | +1 (415) 555-0182
Subject: Re: Next steps after discovery — vendor setup pending (W-9 / portal)

Hey Lauren — thanks for the recap and the materials. Internal update from finance/procurement: we received the W-9 but our vendor onboarding specialist needs the vendor portal invite to match records before ACH is enabled. I requested the invite earlier today but it looks like it hasn’t landed in our system yet (sometimes those come from a noreply address and get filtered).

I’ll follow up on my side with procurement to check spam and acceptance queue. If it helps, can you re-issue the portal invite to procure@blueridge.ai and copy me so I can escalate? We’re still targeting a June kickoff, but procurement is the blocker right now.

Sam Lee
Head of Data Platform | BlueRidge Analytics
sam.lee@blueridge.ai | +1 (650) 555-4433
Subject: Re: Next steps after discovery — vendor setup pending (W-9 / portal)

Hi Sam — just bumping this thread since I haven’t seen acceptance on the portal invite yet. A couple options to unblock quickly:

1) I can re-send the portal invite explicitly to procure@blueridge.ai and procurement@blueridge.com (if that’s a different inbox), and include a short checklist they can copy into their vendor system.
2) If procurement prefers, we can accept a scanned W-9 + manual ACH form via secure upload and have finance set up a temporary billing code while portal acceptance processes.
3) If the timeline slipped, let me know the new priority and I’ll pause scheduling so we don’t reserve onboarding resources unnecessarily.

I included a one-click link to the vendor portal invite in case it makes forwarding easier: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/invite/BR-2027-0421

Attaching the W-9 again (BlueRidge_W9.pdf) — please confirm which approach procurement wants and I’ll coordinate with Karthik to keep the technical kickoff on standby.

Thanks —
Lauren
